    A QUICK CHECK
    MEET NEXTCUE

    A place to pick things up.

    Choose a routine and work through one step at a time. When you are interrupted, pause with an optional note. Resume to see the exact next step, your last completed step, and how long you were away.

    Alexa+ experience simulation

    This standalone prototype demonstrates an interaction concept. It is not connected to Alexa or Amazon. Commands and smaller steps use fixed local rules; there is no AI model, microphone access, account, or application backend.

    Try a command

    • start study Start the study routine
    • start pack Start packing a bag
    • start tidy Start tidying your desk
    • done Complete the current action
    • pause your note Pause and save a cue
    • resume Return to the same action
    • smaller Break a step into smaller actions
    • status Check where you are

    Your space, your data

    By default, your routine lives only in this page’s memory. If you choose “Remember on this device”, the routine and pause note are saved in this browser’s local storage. Conversation history and the timer are never saved. Turning it off removes the saved routine. “Clear saved routine” also resets your current routine.

    Read-aloud is optional and uses your browser’s speech synthesis voice, which may be provided by your browser or device. NextCue does not request microphone access or send your routine to an application backend.
